column1: # ADR-018 register: the ONLY services of the lab that may start without a numeric non-root `user:` (public file, no values).
# Read by scripts/check-container-rules.sh (CI step "Guard - non-root unless ADR-018 lists it"). Adding a service here needs an
#   cap_add   : comma-separated capabilities the service may add back after `cap_drop: [ALL]` ("-" = none)
#   nnp       : required = security_opt must hold no-new-privileges:true; exempt = it may not (the image's entrypoint or the host-network
#               agent needs setuid and file capabilities)
#   why       : one line, for the reader

column4: Joins the tailnet from the host network namespace (tun device, routes)
Root entrypoint sets up, then FTL drops to PIHOLE_UID; binds port 53
Root inside the container to use the Docker socket (ADR-017); no capability is added back
